note: This file is a pure configuration dictionary (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines model settings for an MMSegmentation EncoderDecoder with a NonLocal head and ResNet-50 backbone.
summarize_model_config: summarize the nonlocal_r50-d8 model config which defines an EncoderDecoder with NLHead and ResNetV1c backbone
review_norm_cfg: review the norm_cfg dict that configures SyncBN normalization with requires_grad enabled
review_data_preprocessor: review the data_preprocessor dict that configures SegDataPreProcessor with ImageNet mean/std normalization
review_backbone_config: review the backbone config dict that defines a ResNetV1c depth 50 with atrous convolutions
review_decode_head_config: review the decode_head config dict that defines an NLHead with embedded_gaussian nonlocal mode
